Tools

Free calculators to help you plan a salon visit. Everything runs in your browser — no accounts, no data collection, no stored inputs.

Planning ahead for a salon visit usually comes down to two questions: what will it roughly cost, and how long will it take to reach the look you want. Our two calculators are built to give quick, informational answers to those questions before you ever pick up the phone to book. Neither tool sends your inputs anywhere — the math happens entirely on your device, and nothing is stored once you close the tab. Use them as a starting point for budgeting and planning, then confirm exact pricing and timelines directly with your stylist, since real quotes always depend on the specifics of your hair and the professional you're working with.
